basic_info.description: Welcome to this spacious & beautifully updated split-level home in SF's desirable Portola neighborhood. This residence offers a flexible layout perfect for modern living. Ascending the stairs, youll find an open-concept living & dining area bathed in natural light, offering stunning views of the shipyard & twinkling city lights. Sizable kitchen incl a cozy eat-in area. Down the hall, a bright & airy bathroom boasts a separate shower/tub, a skylight, & thoughtful finishes. 2 generously sized beds w/ picturesque windows complete the upper level. The lower level features 2 addtl spacious beds + bonus full bath, a convenient guest bath w/ a stall shower, & direct access to the beautifully landscaped backyard. Recent upgrades incl fresh int & ext paint, designer light fixtures, brand-new flooring throughout, & a new roof. Enjoy the convenience of a short walk to John McLaren Park, offering miles of trails, playgrounds, & open green spaces for your daily recreation. Plus, w/ easy access to I-280, commuting is a breezewhether you're heading into SF or down to Silicon Valley. With a 2-car garage & a prime location near shops, parks, & major transit routes, this home is ready for its next owners to enjoy. Dont miss this incredible opportunity in one of SF's most charming neighborhoods!
